subject: Velocity gate — coverage sanity check ahead of finance lock
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 08 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Velocity gate — coverage sanity check ahead of finance lock

Team —

Finance lock is coming up next Friday (4/18). I ran a quick pass on pipe-to-quota and there are a few pockets where coverage looks inflated because of long-dormant deals and optimistic close timing. Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (4/10):

- Update stage to the closest canonical stage (Commit / Best case / Pipeline). Avoid custom stages when you intend to count towards coverage.
- Confirm expected close month for all active Commit deals; if a deal slips 60+ days, move to Best case until a new close date is confirmed.
- Remove or flag any opportunities with no activity in 90+ days and no buyer signals.
- Attach any recent customer emails/POs/contracts to the HubSpot deal record.

I've attached the heuristics sheet (coverage_heuristics_v3.xlsx) with a short checklist and examples. Marcus — can you run a sweep for your book and flag top 10 deals that are candidates to be excluded from coverage? Laura — finance will do a quick rules check on commit criteria Tuesday morning and call out any exceptions.

I want a short rollup by Thursday AM so Finance can bake a conservative plan for the lock. No need for long notes — 1-line status per deal. If you think a deal needs leadership review, mark it with HIGHPRIORITY in the HubSpot notes and copy me.

Thanks,
Sergio
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: coverage_heuristics_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 08 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Velocity gate — coverage sanity check ahead of finance lock

Sergio —

Thanks for the heads-up. Finance will run the commit-definition pass Tuesday 4/9 at 10:00 PT. Quick clarifications before we start:

- Our working definition of Commit for the lock is: signed LOI/PO in place OR explicit written commit from buyer + corroborating internal CS/AM notes.
- For multi-entity deals (e.g., reseller + end-customer) we count only the end-customer portion toward quota until legal confirms MOU.

I'll kick off a short meeting invite for Tue 10:00 where Marcus (and any reps with >$100k in Commit) should join with their top 8 Commit deals. We'll use the attached checklist and mark any deals that need an exception.

Also attaching the NorthWorks MOU draft we received last week — Marcus, this one looks close but legal needs a signature page. If you can surface where this sits in your process, we'll decide treatment.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: northworks_MOU_draft.pdf (pdf)
Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/8675309

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 08 Apr 2025 14:22:00 -0700

Got it — I'll run the sweep and post a 1-line status for each Commit by Wednesday EOD. Preliminary notes for the sweep:

- NorthWorks (NW-2025-07) — LOI received, PO pending; AM has verbal confirmation from buyer, legal awaiting signature page. I'll mark as Commit with an exception note and surface in Tue 10:00 meeting.
- Two deals in EMEA where close dates are Nov 2025 but opportunity record has 'this quarter' in notes — will correct close months and drop to Best case if reps can't confirm.
- I'll also remove 5 stale opps with zero activity in the last 120 days.

I'll bring a 1-slide rollup for the meeting. Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
